当前文件夹中是一个OpenVela Vendor Overlay工程，在这里修改的代码会自动软链接到/home/lxy/openvela/vendor/espressif，并且加入编译。
编译时，会自动拉取依赖放到
/home/lxy/openvela/cmake_out/esp32p4-function-ev-board_esp_hosted/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif
并且自动添加头文件目录等，因此你可以直接include其中的头文件。
在/home/lxy/openvela/nuttx/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3里面，有一些较为完善的ESP32-S3BSP。注意：ESP32P4是Risc-V架构，代码逻辑、DMA、GPIO交换矩阵等和ESP32S3有很大区别，因此不能直接照搬ESP32S3的代码逻辑，需要根据esp-hal-3rdparty里面的相关代码，实现ESP32-P4的BSP。
nuttx其它文件位于：/home/lxy/openvela/nuttx
现在需要你基于上述资料，分析并实现ESP32P4的SDIO支持。
注意：在编写代码时，只能修改位于当前文件夹中的代码：/home/lxy/openvela/contest2026_128_xiaolidianzishiyanshi
不能修改其它文件夹中的代码。如果只修改当前文件夹中的代码无法实现目标需求，或者需要进行不符合编码规范的动作（Workaround）时，应当立即停止实现，并报告原因，由用户决定下一步的实现方向。
只需要考虑CMake构建系统，不需要考虑传统的Makefile
ESP32P4有2个SDIO接口，一个用于连接外置TF卡，另一个用来通过ESP-Hosted-MCU协议与板载ESP32-C6通信。
我正在移植ESP-Hosted-MCU协议，现在需要补全ESP32-P4的SDIO接口层支持。

你参考现在位于
/home/lxy/openvela/contest2026_128_xiaolidianzishiyanshi/chip/esp32p4/esp32p4_sdmmc.c
的骨架代码，还有esp-idf的基于ll库的版本
/home/lxy/openvela/esp_driver_sdmmc
（ll库位于/home/lxy/openvela/cmake_out/esp32p4-function-ev-board_esp_hosted/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp-hal-3rdparty/components/esp_hal_sd）
，分析ESP32P4平台的实现方案，并且对于nuttx的每个函数，逐一完成这一支持。
（骨架代码中，未使用的函数可删除）
注意：你需要按你的顺序完成实现，但实现时每次最多完成单个函数，并且检查它和其它函数是否存在冲突。

222	/****************************************************************************
223	 * Name: esp32p4_getreg
224	 *
225	 * Description:
226	 *   This function may to used to intercept an monitor all register accesses.
227	 *   Clearly this is nothing you would want to do unless you are debugging
228	 *   this driver.
229	 *
230	 * Input Parameters:
231	 *   addr - The register address to read
232	 *
233	 * Returned Value:
234	 *   The value read from the register
235	 *
236	 ****************************************************************************/
237	
238	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_REGDEBUG
239	static uint32_t __esp32p4_getreg(const char* func, uint32_t addr) {
240	  static uint32_t prevaddr = 0;
241	  static uint32_t preval = 0;
242	  static uint32_t count = 0;
243	
244	  /* Read the value from the register */
245	
246	  uint32_t val = getreg32(addr);
247	
248	  /* Is this the same value that we read from the same register last time?
249	   * Are we polling the register?  If so, suppress some of the output.
250	   */
251	
252	  if (addr == prevaddr && val == preval) {
253	    if (count == 0xffffffff || ++count > 3) {
254	      if (count == 4) {
255	        mcerr("%s: ...\n", func);
256	      }
257	
258	      return val;
259	    }
260	  }
261	
262	  /* No this is a new address or value */
263	
264	  else {
265	    /* Did we print "..." for the previous value? */
266	
267	    if (count > 3) {
268	      /* Yes.. then show how many times the value repeated */
269	
270	      mcerr("%s: [repeats %d more times]\n", func, count - 3);
271	    }
272	
273	    /* Save the new address, value, and count */
274	
275	    prevaddr = addr;
276	    preval = val;
277	    count = 1;
278	  }
279	
280	  /* Show the register value read */
281	
282	  mcerr("%s: %08x->%08x\n", func, addr, val);
283	  return val;
284	}
285	#endif

55	/* SDIOWAIT_WRCOMPLETE (optional) : Certain SDIO driver can use D0 busy
56	 *   signaling to detect Write Complete.  Used of D0 busy signaling will
57	 *   avoid potentially very long (600Ms+) busy waiting in the MMCSD driver.
58	 *
59	 *   To implement D0 Busy signaling, the underlying SDIO driver must be
60	 *   capable of switching the D0 GPIO to be a rising edge sensitive
61	 *   interrupt pin. It must then, condition that pin to detect the rising
62	 *   edge on receipt of SDWAIT_WRCOMPLETE in the SDIO_WAITENABLE call and
63	 *   return it back to regular SDIO mode, when either the ISR fires or pin
64	 *   is found to be high in the SDIO_EVENTWAIT call.
65	 */

717	/****************************************************************************
718	 * Name: SDIO_WAITENABLE
719	 *
720	 * Description:
721	 *   Enable/disable of a set of SDIO wait events.  This is part of the
722	 *   the SDIO_WAITEVENT sequence.  The set of to-be-waited-for events is
723	 *   configured before calling either calling SDIO_DMARECVSETUP,
724	 *   SDIO_DMASENDSETUP, or SDIO_WAITEVENT.  This is the recommended
725	 *   ordering:
726	 *
727	 *     SDIO_WAITENABLE:    Discard any pending interrupts, enable event(s)
728	 *                         of interest
729	 *     SDIO_DMARECVSETUP/
730	 *     SDIO_DMASENDSETUP:  Setup the logic that will trigger the event the
731	 *                         event(s) of interest
732	 *     SDIO_WAITEVENT:     Wait for the event of interest (which might
733	 *                         already have occurred)
734	 *
735	 *   This sequence should eliminate race conditions between the command/
736	 *   transfer setup and the subsequent events.
737	 *
738	 *   The enabled events persist until either (1) SDIO_WAITENABLE is called
739	 *   again specifying a different set of wait events, or (2) SDIO_EVENTWAIT
740	 *   returns.
741	 *
742	 * Input Parameters:
743	 *   dev      - An instance of the SDIO device interface
744	 *   eventset - A bitset of events to enable or disable (see SDIOWAIT_*
745	 *              definitions). 0=disable; 1=enable.
746	 *   timeout  - Maximum time in milliseconds to wait.  Zero means immediate
747	 *              timeout with no wait.  The timeout value is ignored if
748	 *              SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT is not included in the waited-for eventset.
749	 *
750	 * Returned Value:
751	 *   None
752	 *
753	 ****************************************************************************/
754	
755	#define SDIO_WAITENABLE(dev,eventset,timeout) ((dev)->waitenable(dev,eventset,timeout))
756

764	 *   can be used again.
765	 *
766	 * Input Parameters:

769	 * Returned Value:

838	 *   buffer - The memory to DMA to/from
839	 *   buflen - The size of the DMA transfer in bytes

853	/****************************************************************************
854	 * Name: SDIO_DMARECVSETUP
855	 *
856	 * Description:
857	 *   Setup to perform a read DMA.  If the processor supports a data cache,
858	 *   then this method will also make sure that the contents of the DMA memory
859	 *   and the data cache are coherent.  For read transfers this may mean
860	 *   invalidating the data cache.  Upon return, DMA is enable and waiting.
861	 *
862	 * Input Parameters:
863	 *   dev    - An instance of the SDIO device interface
864	 *   buffer - The memory to DMA from
865	 *   buflen - The size of the DMA transfer in bytes
866	 *
867	 * Returned Value:
868	 *   OK on success; a negated errno on failure
869	 *
870	 ****************************************************************************/
871	
872	#ifdef CONFIG_SDIO_DMA
873	#  define SDIO_DMARECVSETUP(dev,buffer,len) ((dev)->dmarecvsetup(dev,buffer,len))
874	#else
875	#  define SDIO_DMARECVSETUP(dev,buffer,len) (-ENOSYS)
876	#endif

878	/****************************************************************************
879	 * Name: SDIO_DMASENDSETUP
880	 *
881	 * Description:
882	 *   Setup to perform a write DMA.  If the processor supports a data cache,
883	 *   then this method will also make sure that the contents of the DMA memory
884	 *   and the data cache are coherent.  For write transfers, this may mean
885	 *   flushing the data cache.  Upon return, DMA is enable and waiting.
886	 *
887	 * Input Parameters:
888	 *   dev    - An instance of the SDIO device interface
889	 *   buffer - The memory to DMA into
890	 *   buflen - The size of the DMA transfer in bytes
891	 *
892	 * Returned Value:
893	 *   OK on success; a negated errno on failure
894	 *
895	 ****************************************************************************/
896	
897	#ifdef CONFIG_SDIO_DMA
898	#  define SDIO_DMASENDSETUP(dev,buffer,len) ((dev)->dmasendsetup(dev,buffer,len))
899	#else
900	#  define SDIO_DMASENDSETUP(dev,buffer,len) (-ENOSYS)
901	#endif

404	/****************************************************************************
405	 * Name: esp32s3_getreg
406	 *
407	 * Description:
408	 *   This function may to used to intercept an monitor all register accesses.
409	 *   Clearly this is nothing you would want to do unless you are debugging
410	 *   this driver.
411	 *
412	 * Input Parameters:
413	 *   addr - The register address to read
414	 *
415	 * Returned Value:
416	 *   The value read from the register
417	 *
418	 ****************************************************************************/
419	
420	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32S3_SDMMC_REGDEBUG
421	static uint32_t __esp32s3_getreg(const char *func, uint32_t addr)
422	{
423	  static uint32_t prevaddr = 0;
424	  static uint32_t preval   = 0;
425	  static uint32_t count    = 0;
426	
427	  /* Read the value from the register */
428	
429	  uint32_t val = getreg32(addr);
430	
431	  /* Is this the same value that we read from the same register last time?
432	   * Are we polling the register?  If so, suppress some of the output.
433	   */
434	
435	  if (addr == prevaddr && val == preval)
436	    {
437	      if (count == 0xffffffff || ++count > 3)
438	        {
439	          if (count == 4)
440	            {
441	              mcerr("%s: ...\n", func);
442	            }
443	
444	          return val;
445	        }
446	    }
447	
448	  /* No this is a new address or value */
449	
450	  else
451	    {
452	      /* Did we print "..." for the previous value? */
453	
454	      if (count > 3)
455	        {
456	          /* Yes.. then show how many times the value repeated */
457	
458	          mcerr("%s: [repeats %d more times]\n", func, count - 3);
459	        }
460	
461	      /* Save the new address, value, and count */
462	
463	      prevaddr = addr;
464	      preval   = val;
465	      count    = 1;
466	    }
467	
468	  /* Show the register value read */
469	
470	  mcerr("%s: %08x->%08x\n", func, addr, val);
471	  return val;
472	}
473	#endif

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: esp32p4_recvlong
 *
 * Description:
 *   Receive response to SDIO command.  Only the critical payload is
 *   returned -- 128 bits for 136 bit status.  The driver implementation
 *   verifies the correctness of the remaining, non-returned bits (CRCs, CMD
 *   index, etc.).
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   dev  - An instance of the SDIO device interface
 *   cmd  - The command that was sent
 *   rlong - Buffer in which to receive the response (4 x 32-bit)
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   OK on success; a negated errno on failure.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

static int esp32p4_recvlong(struct sdio_dev_s *dev, uint32_t cmd,
                            uint32_t rlong[4])
{
  mcinfo("cmd: %08" PRIx32 "\n", cmd);

  /* Read the long response from the response registers.
   * The SDMMC controller stores the response in reverse order:
   * resp[0] = bits [127:96]
   * resp[1] = bits [95:64]
   * resp[2] = bits [63:32]
   * resp[3] = bits [31:0]
   *
   * NuttX expects:
   * rlong[0] = bits [127:96]
   * rlong[1] = bits [95:64]
   * rlong[2] = bits [63:32]
   * rlong[3] = bits [31:0]
   */

  rlong[0] = SDMMC.resp[3];
  rlong[1] = SDMMC.resp[2];
  rlong[2] = SDMMC.resp[1];
  rlong[3] = SDMMC.resp[0];

  mcinfo("response: %08" PRIx32 " %08" PRIx32 " %08" PRIx32 " %08" PRIx32
         "\n", rlong[0], rlong[1], rlong[2], rlong[3]);

  return OK;
}

347	/****************************************************************************
348	 * Name: esp32p4_getreg
349	 *
350	 * Description:
351	 *   This function may to used to intercept an monitor all register accesses.
352	 *   Clearly this is nothing you would want to do unless you are debugging
353	 *   this driver.
354	 *
355	 * Input Parameters:
356	 *   addr - The register address to read
357	 *
358	 * Returned Value:
359	 *   The value read from the register
360	 *
361	 ****************************************************************************/
362	
363	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_REGDEBUG
364	static uint32_t __esp32p4_getreg(const char* func, uint32_t addr) {
365	  static uint32_t prevaddr = 0;
366	  static uint32_t preval = 0;
367	  static uint32_t count = 0;
368	
369	  /* Read the value from the register */
370	
371	  uint32_t val = getreg32(addr);
372	
373	  /* Is this the same value that we read from the same register last time?
374	   * Are we polling the register?  If so, suppress some of the output.
375	   */
376	
377	  if (addr == prevaddr && val == preval) {
378	    if (count == 0xffffffff || ++count > 3) {
379	      if (count == 4) {
380	        mcerr("%s: ...\n", func);
381	      }
382	
383	      return val;
384	    }
385	  }
386	
387	  /* No this is a new address or value */
388	
389	  else {
390	    /* Did we print "..." for the previous value? */
391	
392	    if (count > 3) {
393	      /* Yes.. then show how many times the value repeated */
394	
395	      mcerr("%s: [repeats %d more times]\n", func, count - 3);
396	    }
397	
398	    /* Save the new address, value, and count */
399	
400	    prevaddr = addr;
401	    preval = val;
402	    count = 1;
403	  }
404	
405	  /* Show the register value read */
406	
407	  mcerr("%s: %08x->%08x\n", func, addr, val);
408	  return val;
409	}
410	#endif

441	/****************************************************************************
442	 * Name: esp32p4_ciu_sendcmd
443	 *
444	 * Description:
445	 *   Function to send command to Card interface unit (CIU)
446	 *
447	 * Input Parameters:
448	 *   cmd - The command to be executed
449	 *   arg - The argument to use with the command.
450	 *
451	 * Returned Value:
452	 *   Returns zero on success.  One will be returned on a timeout.
453	 *
454	 ****************************************************************************/
455	
456	static int esp32p4_ciu_sendcmd(uint32_t cmd, uint32_t arg)
457	{
458	  sdmmc_hw_cmd_t cmd_val;
459	  clock_t watchtime;
460	
461	  watchtime = clock_systime_ticks();
462	
463	  /* Wait for previous command to be taken by CIU */
464	
465	  while (!sdmmc_ll_is_command_taken(&SDMMC))
466	    {
467	      if (clock_systime_ticks() - watchtime > SDCARD_CMDTIMEOUT)
468	        {
469	          mcerr("TMO Timed out waiting for command taken (%08" PRIx32 ")\n",
470	                SDMMC.cmd.val);
471	          return 1;
472	        }
473	    }
474	
475	  /* Build the command register value from NuttX command encoding */
476	
477	  memset(&cmd_val, 0, sizeof(cmd_val));
478	
479	  /* Command index (bits 0-5) */
480	
481	  cmd_val.cmd_index = (cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) >> MMCSD_CMDIDX_SHIFT;
482	
483	  /* Response type (bits 6-9) */
484	
485	  uint32_t resp = (cmd & MMCSD_RESPONSE_MASK) >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT;
486	
487	  switch (resp)
488	    {
489	      case MMCSD_NO_RESPONSE >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT:
490	        /* No response */
491	        break;
492	
493	      case MMCSD_R1_RESPONSE >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT:
494	      case MMCSD_R1B_RESPONSE >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT:
495	        cmd_val.response_expect = 1;
496	        cmd_val.check_response_crc = 1;
497	        break;
498	
499	      case MMCSD_R2_RESPONSE >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT:
500	        cmd_val.response_expect = 1;
501	        cmd_val.response_long = 1;
502	        cmd_val.check_response_crc = 1;
503	        break;
504	
505	      case MMCSD_R3_RESPONSE >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT:
506	        cmd_val.response_expect = 1;
507	        /* R3 has no CRC */
508	        break;
509	
510	      case MMCSD_R4_RESPONSE >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT:
511	        cmd_val.response_expect = 1;
512	        break;
513	
514	      case MMCSD_R5_RESPONSE >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT:
515	        cmd_val.response_expect = 1;
516	        cmd_val.check_response_crc = 1;
517	        break;
518	
519	      case MMCSD_R6_RESPONSE >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT:
520	        cmd_val.response_expect = 1;
521	        cmd_val.check_response_crc = 1;
522	        break;
523	
524	      case MMCSD_R7_RESPONSE >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT:
525	        cmd_val.response_expect = 1;
526	        break;
527	
528	      default:
529	        mcerr("ERROR: Unknown response type: %" PRIx32 "\n", resp);
530	        break;
531	    }
532	
533	  /* Data transfer (bits 10-12) */
534	
535	  uint32_t xfr = (cmd & MMCSD_DATAXFR_MASK) >> MMCSD_DATAXFR_SHIFT;
536	
537	  if (xfr != 0)
538	    {
539	      cmd_val.data_expected = 1;
540	
541	      if (cmd & MMCSD_WRXFR)
542	        {
543	          cmd_val.rw = 1;  /* Write */
544	        }
545	
546	      if (cmd & MMCSD_STREAM)
547	        {
548	          cmd_val.transfer_mode = 1;  /* Stream mode */
549	        }
550	    }
551	
552	  /* Send auto stop for multiblock transfers */
553	
554	  if (cmd & MMCSD_MULTIBLOCK)
555	    {
556	      /* Don't send auto-stop; we'll send CMD12 manually */
557	
558	      cmd_val.send_auto_stop = 0;
559	    }
560	
561	  if (cmd & MMCSD_STOPXFR)
562	    {
563	      cmd_val.stop_abort_cmd = 1;
564	    }
565	
566	  /* Wait for previous data transfer to complete */
567	
568	  cmd_val.wait_complete = 1;
569	
570	  /* Send initialization sequence (80 clocks) for CMD0 */
571	
572	  if ((cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) == 0)
573	    {
574	      /* Don't send init sequence here, it's handled separately */
575	
576	      cmd_val.send_init = 0;
577	    }
578	
579	  /* Use hold register for synchronization */
580	
581	  cmd_val.use_hold_reg = 1;
582	
583	  /* Set card number */
584	
585	  cmd_val.card_num = 0;
586	
587	  /* Start command */
588	
589	  cmd_val.start_command = 1;
590	
591	  /* Set argument and send command */
592	
593	  sdmmc_ll_set_command_arg(&SDMMC, arg);
594	  sdmmc_ll_set_command(&SDMMC, cmd_val);
595	
596	  mcinfo("cmd=0x%" PRIx32 " arg=0x%" PRIx32 " cmd_val=0x%x\n",
597	         cmd, arg, cmd_val.val);
598	
599	  return 0;
600	}

641	 *   priv - A reference to the SD card device state structure
642	 *

645	 *
646	 ****************************************************************************/
647	
648	static void esp32p4_enable_ints(struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv)
649	{
650	  uint32_t regval;
651	
652	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_DMA
653	  mcinfo("waitmask=%04" PRIx32 " xfrmask=%04" PRIx32 " dmamask=%04" PRIx32
654	         " RINTSTS=%08" PRIx32 "\n",

666	
667	  regval = priv->xfrmask | priv->waitmask | SDCARD_INT_CDET;

669	  sdmmc_ll_enable_interrupt(&SDMMC, regval, true);

702	/****************************************************************************
703	 * Name: esp32p4_config_waitints
704	 *
705	 * Description:
706	 *   Enable/disable SD card interrupts needed to support the wait function
707	 *
708	 * Input Parameters:
709	 *   priv       - A reference to the SD card device state structure
710	 *   waitmask   - The set of bits in the SD card INTMASK register to set
711	 *   waitevents - Waited for events
712	 *   wkupevent  - Wake-up events
713	 *
714	 * Returned Value:
715	 *   None
716	 *
717	 ****************************************************************************/
718	
719	static void esp32p4_config_waitints(struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv,
720	                                    uint32_t waitmask,
721	                                    sdio_eventset_t waitevents,
722	                                    sdio_eventset_t wkupevent)
723	{
724	  irqstate_t flags;
725	
726	  mcinfo("waitevents=%04x wkupevent=%04x\n",
727	         (unsigned)waitevents, (unsigned)wkupevent);
728	
729	  /* Save all of the data and set the new interrupt mask in one, atomic
730	   * operation.
731	   */
732	
733	  flags            = enter_critical_section();
734	  priv->waitevents = waitevents;
735	  priv->wkupevent  = wkupevent;
736	  priv->waitmask   = waitmask;
737	
738	  esp32p4_enable_ints(priv);
739	  leave_critical_section(flags);
740	}

749	 *   priv    - A reference to the SD card device state structure

751	 *
752	 * Returned Value:

754	 *

757	static void esp32p4_config_xfrints(struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv,
758	                                   uint32_t xfrmask)
759	{
760	  irqstate_t flags;
761	  flags = enter_critical_section();
762	
763	  priv->xfrmask = xfrmask;
764	  esp32p4_enable_ints(priv);
765	
766	  leave_critical_section(flags);
767	}

769	/****************************************************************************
770	 * Name: esp32p4_eventtimeout
771	 *
772	 * Description:
773	 *   The watchdog timeout setup when the event wait start has expired without
774	 *   any other waited-for event occurring.
775	 *
776	 * Input Parameters:
777	 *   arg    - The argument
778	 *
779	 * Returned Value:
780	 *   None
781	 *
782	 * Assumptions:
783	 *   Always called from the interrupt level with interrupts disabled.
784	 *
785	 ****************************************************************************/
786	
787	static void esp32p4_eventtimeout(wdparm_t arg)
788	{
789	  struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32p4_dev_s *)arg;
790	
791	  /* There is always race conditions with timer expirations. */
792	
793	  DEBUGASSERT((priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT) != 0 ||
794	              priv->wkupevent != 0);
795	
796	  /* Is a data transfer complete event expected? */
797	
798	  if ((priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT) != 0)
799	    {
800	      /* Yes.. wake up any waiting threads */
801	
802	      esp32p4_endwait(priv, SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT);
803	      mcerr("Timeout: remaining: %d\n", priv->remaining);
804	    }
805	}
806	
807	/****************************************************************************
808	 * Name: esp32p4_endwait
809	 *
810	 * Description:
811	 *   Wake up a waiting thread if the waited-for event has occurred.
812	 *
813	 * Input Parameters:
814	 *   priv      - An instance of the SDIO device interface
815	 *   wkupevent - The event that caused the wait to end
816	 *
817	 * Returned Value:
818	 *   None
819	 *
820	 * Assumptions:
821	 *   Always called from the interrupt level with interrupts disabled.
822	 *
823	 ****************************************************************************/
824	
825	static void esp32p4_endwait(struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv,
826	                            sdio_eventset_t wkupevent)
827	{
828	  mcinfo("wkupevent=%04x\n", (unsigned)wkupevent);
829	
830	  /* Cancel the watchdog timeout */
831	
832	  wd_cancel(&priv->waitwdog);
833	
834	  /* Disable event-related interrupts */
835	
836	  esp32p4_config_waitints(priv, 0, 0, wkupevent);
837	
838	  /* Wake up the waiting thread */
839	
840	  nxsem_post(&priv->waitsem);
841	}

843	/****************************************************************************
844	 * Name: esp32p4_endtransfer
845	 *
846	 * Description:
847	 *   Terminate a transfer with the provided status.  This function is called
848	 *   only from the SDIO interrupt handler when end-of-transfer conditions
849	 *   are detected.
850	 *
851	 * Input Parameters:
852	 *   priv   - An instance of the SDIO device interface
853	 *   wkupevent - The event that caused the transfer to end
854	 *
855	 * Returned Value:
856	 *   None
857	 *
858	 * Assumptions:
859	 *   Always called from the interrupt level with interrupts disabled.
860	 *
861	 ****************************************************************************/
862	
863	static void esp32p4_endtransfer(struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv,
864	                                sdio_eventset_t wkupevent)
865	{
866	  mcinfo("wkupevent=%04x\n", (unsigned)wkupevent);
867	
868	  /* Disable all transfer related interrupts */
869	
870	  esp32p4_config_xfrints(priv, 0);
871	
872	  /* Clearing pending interrupt status on all transfer related interrupts */
873	
874	  sdmmc_ll_clear_interrupt(&SDMMC, priv->waitmask);
875	
876	  /* Mark the transfer finished */
877	
878	  priv->remaining = 0;
879	
880	  /* Is a thread wait for these data transfer complete events? */
881	
882	  if ((priv->waitevents & wkupevent) != 0)
883	    {
884	      /* Yes.. wake up any waiting threads */
885	
886	      esp32p4_endwait(priv, wkupevent);
887	    }
888	}

894	 *   SDIO interrupt handler
895	 *
896	 * Input Parameters:
897	 *   dev - An instance of the SDIO device interface
898	 *
899	 * Returned Value:
900	 *   None
901	 *
902	 ****************************************************************************/
903	
904	static int esp32p4_interrupt(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
905	{
906	  struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv = arg;
907	  uint32_t enabled;
908	  uint32_t pending;
909	
910	  /* Loop while there are pending interrupts.  Check the SD card status
911	   * register.  Mask out all bits that don't correspond to enabled
912	   * interrupts.  (This depends on the fact that bits are ordered
913	   * the same in both the STA and MASK register).  If there are non-zero
914	   * bits remaining, then we have work to do here.
915	   */
916	
917	  while ((enabled = sdmmc_ll_get_intr_status(&SDMMC)) != 0)
918	    {
919	      /* Clear pending status */
920	
921	      sdmmc_ll_clear_interrupt(&SDMMC, enabled);
922	
923	#ifdef CONFIG_MMCSD_HAVE_CARDDETECT
924	      /* Handle in card detection events ************************************/
925	
926	      if ((enabled & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_CD) != 0)
927	        {
928	          sdio_statset_t cdstatus;
929	
930	          /* Update card status */
931	
932	          cdstatus = priv->cdstatus;
933	          if (!sdmmc_ll_is_card_detected(&SDMMC, priv->slot))
934	            {
935	              priv->cdstatus |= SDIO_STATUS_PRESENT;
936	
937	#ifdef CONFIG_MMCSD_HAVE_WRITEPROTECT
938	              if (sdmmc_ll_is_card_write_protected(&SDMMC, priv->slot))
939	                {
940	                  priv->cdstatus |= SDIO_STATUS_WRPROTECTED;
941	                }
942	              else
943	#endif
944	                {
945	                  priv->cdstatus &= ~SDIO_STATUS_WRPROTECTED;
946	                }
947	            }
948	          else
949	            {
950	              priv->cdstatus &=
951	                ~(SDIO_STATUS_PRESENT | SDIO_STATUS_WRPROTECTED);
952	            }
953	
954	          mcinfo("cdstatus OLD: %02x NEW: %02x\n", cdstatus, priv->cdstatus);
955	
956	          /* Perform any requested callback if the status has changed */
957	
958	          if (cdstatus != priv->cdstatus)
959	            {
960	              esp32p4_callback(priv);
961	            }
962	        }
963	#endif
964	
965	      /* Handle data transfer events ****************************************/
966	
967	      pending = enabled & priv->xfrmask;
968	      if (pending != 0)
969	        {
970	          /* Handle data request events */
971	
972	          if ((pending & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_TXDR) != 0)
973	            {
974	              uint32_t status;
975	
976	              /* Transfer data to the TX FIFO */
977	
978	              DEBUGASSERT(priv->wrdir);
979	
980	              for (status = SDMMC.status.val;
981	                   (status & SDMMC_STATUS_FIFOFULL) == 0 &&
982	                   priv->remaining > 0;
983	                   status = SDMMC.status.val)
984	                {
985	                  SDMMC.buffifo.val = *priv->buffer;
986	                  priv->buffer++;
987	                  priv->remaining -= 4;
988	                }
989	            }
990	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RXDR) != 0)
991	            {
992	              uint32_t status;
993	
994	              /* Transfer data from the RX FIFO */
995	
996	              DEBUGASSERT(!priv->wrdir);
997	
998	              for (status = SDMMC.status.val;
999	                   (status & SDMMC_STATUS_FIFOEMPTY) == 0 &&
1000	                   priv->remaining > 0;
1001	                   status = SDMMC.status.val)
1002	                {
1003	                  *priv->buffer = SDMMC.buffifo.val;
1004	                  priv->buffer++;
1005	                  priv->remaining -= 4;
1006	                }
1007	            }
1008	
1009	          /* Check for transfer errors */
1010	
1011	          /* Handle data block send/receive CRC failure */
1012	
1013	          if ((pending & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_DCRC) != 0)
1014	            {
1015	              /* Terminate the transfer with an error */
1016	
1017	              mcerr("ERROR: Data CRC failure, pending=%08" PRIx32
1018	                    " remaining: %d\n", pending, priv->remaining);
1019	
1020	              esp32p4_endtransfer(priv,
1021	                                  SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE | SDIOWAIT_ERROR);
1022	            }
1023	
1024	          /* Handle data timeout error */
1025	
1026	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RTO) != 0)
1027	            {
1028	              /* Terminate the transfer with an error */
1029	
1030	              mcerr("ERROR: Data timeout, pending=%08" PRIx32
1031	                    " remaining: %d\n", pending, priv->remaining);
1032	
1033	              esp32p4_endtransfer(priv,
1034	                                  SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE | SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT);
1035	            }
1036	
1037	          /* Handle RX FIFO overrun error */
1038	
1039	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_FRUN) != 0)
1040	            {
1041	              /* Terminate the transfer with an error */
1042	
1043	              mcerr("ERROR: RX FIFO overrun, pending=%08" PRIx32
1044	                    " remaining: %d\n", pending, priv->remaining);
1045	
1046	              esp32p4_endtransfer(priv,
1047	                                  SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE | SDIOWAIT_ERROR);
1048	            }
1049	
1050	          /* Handle start bit error */
1051	
1052	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_SBE) != 0)
1053	            {
1054	              /* Terminate the transfer with an error */
1055	
1056	              mcerr("ERROR: Start bit, pending=%08" PRIx32
1057	                    " remaining: %d\n", pending, priv->remaining);
1058	
1059	              esp32p4_endtransfer(priv,
1060	                                  SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE | SDIOWAIT_ERROR);
1061	            }
1062	
1063	          /* Handle data end events.  Note that RXDR may accompany DTO, DTO
1064	           * will be set on received while there is still data in the FIFO.
1065	           * So for the case of receiving, we don't actually even enable the
1066	           * DTO interrupt.
1067	           */
1068	
1069	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_DTO) != 0)
1070	            {
1071	              /* Finish the transfer */
1072	
1073	              esp32p4_endtransfer(priv, SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE);
1074	            }
1075	        }
1076	
1077	      /* Handle wait events *************************************************/
1078	
1079	      pending = enabled & priv->waitmask;
1080	      if (pending != 0)
1081	        {
1082	          /* Is this a response error event? */
1083	
1084	          if ((pending & SDCARD_INT_RESPERR) != 0)
1085	            {
1086	              /* If response errors are enabled, then we must certainly be
1087	               * waiting for a response.
1088	               */
1089	
1090	              DEBUGASSERT((priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_RESPONSEDONE) != 0);
1091	
1092	              /* Wake the thread up */
1093	
1094	              mcerr("ERROR: Response error, pending=%08" PRIx32 "\n", pending);
1095	              esp32p4_endwait(priv, SDIOWAIT_RESPONSEDONE | SDIOWAIT_ERROR);
1096	            }
1097	
1098	          /* Is this a command (plus response) completion event? */
1099	
1100	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_CMD_DONE) != 0)
1101	            {
1102	              /* Yes.. Is their a thread waiting for response done? */
1103	
1104	              if ((priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_RESPONSEDONE) != 0)
1105	                {
1106	                  /* Yes.. wake the thread up */
1107	
1108	                  esp32p4_endwait(priv, SDIOWAIT_RESPONSEDONE);
1109	                }
1110	
1111	              /* NO.. Is their a thread waiting for command done? */
1112	
1113	              else if ((priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_CMDDONE) != 0)
1114	                {
1115	                  /* Yes.. wake the thread up */
1116	
1117	                  esp32p4_endwait(priv, SDIOWAIT_CMDDONE);
1118	                }
1119	            }
1120	        }
1121	    }
1122	
1123	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_DMA
1124	  /* DMA error events *******************************************************/
1125	
1126	  pending = sdmmc_ll_get_idsts_interrupt_raw(&SDMMC);
1127	  if ((pending & priv->dmamask) != 0)
1128	    {
1129	      mcerr("ERROR: IDTS=%08" PRIx32 "\n", (uint32_t)pending);
1130	
1131	      /* Clear the pending interrupts */
1132	
1133	      sdmmc_ll_clear_idsts_interrupt(&SDMMC, pending);
1134	
1135	      /* Abort the transfer */
1136	
1137	      esp32p4_endtransfer(priv, SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE | SDIOWAIT_ERROR);
1138	    }
1139	#endif
1140	
1141	  return OK;
1142	}

1175	/****************************************************************************
1176	 * Name: esp32p4_reset
1177	 *
1178	 * Description:
1179	 *   Reset the SDIO controller.  Undo all setup and initialization.
1180	 *
1181	 * Input Parameters:
1182	 *   dev    - An instance of the SDIO device interface
1183	 *
1184	 * Returned Value:
1185	 *   None
1186	 *
1187	 ****************************************************************************/
1188	
1189	static void esp32p4_reset(struct sdio_dev_s *dev)
1190	{
1191	  struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32p4_dev_s *)dev;
1192	  irqstate_t flags;
1193	
1194	  mcinfo("Resetting...\n");
1195	
1196	  flags = enter_critical_section();
1197	
1198	  /* Reset all blocks */
1199	
1200	  sdmmc_ll_reset_controller(&SDMMC);
1201	  sdmmc_ll_reset_dma(&SDMMC);
1202	  sdmmc_ll_reset_fifo(&SDMMC);
1203	
1204	  /* Wait for reset to complete */
1205	
1206	  while (!sdmmc_ll_is_controller_reset_done(&SDMMC) ||
1207	         !sdmmc_ll_is_dma_reset_done(&SDMMC) ||
1208	         !sdmmc_ll_is_fifo_reset_done(&SDMMC))
1209	    {
1210	    }
1211	
1212	  /* Initialize phase delays */
1213	
1214	  sdmmc_ll_init_phase_delay(&SDMMC);
1215	
1216	  /* Set card clock divider - slot selects clock divider */
1217	
1218	  sdmmc_ll_set_card_clock_div(&SDMMC, priv->slot, priv->slot);
1219	
1220	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_DMA
1221	  sdmmc_ll_set_desc_addr(&SDMMC, (uint32_t)&priv->dma_desc[0]);
1222	#endif
1223	
1224	  /* Reset data */
1225	
1226	  priv->waitevents = 0;      /* Set of events to be waited for */
1227	  priv->waitmask   = 0;      /* Interrupt enables for event waiting */
1228	  priv->wkupevent  = 0;      /* The event that caused the wakeup */
1229	
1230	  wd_cancel(&priv->waitwdog); /* Cancel any timeouts */
1231	
1232	  /* Interrupt mode data transfer support */
1233	
1234	  priv->buffer     = 0;      /* Address of current R/W buffer */
1235	  priv->remaining  = 0;      /* Number of bytes remaining in the transfer */
1236	  priv->xfrmask    = 0;      /* Interrupt enables for data transfer */
1237	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_DMA
1238	  priv->dmamask    = 0;      /* Interrupt enables for DMA transfer */
1239	#endif
1240	
1241	  /* DMA data transfer support */
1242	
1243	  priv->cdstatus   = 0;      /* Card status is unknown */
1244	
1245	  leave_critical_section(flags);
1246	}

1348	/****************************************************************************
1349	 * Name: sdmmc_host_clock_update_command
1350	 *
1351	 * Description:
1352	 *   Send a clock update command to CIU. This is not a real command;
1353	 *   it just updates CIU registers (CLKDIV, CLKSRC, CLKENA).
1354	 *
1355	 * Input Parameters:
1356	 *   priv - A reference to the SD card device state structure
1357	 *
1358	 * Returned Value:
1359	 *   OK on success; a negated errno on failure
1360	 *
1361	 ****************************************************************************/
1362	
1363	static int sdmmc_host_clock_update_command(struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv)
1364	{
1365	  sdmmc_hw_cmd_t cmd_val;
1366	  clock_t watchtime;
1367	
1368	  memset(&cmd_val, 0, sizeof(cmd_val));
1369	  cmd_val.update_clk_reg = 1;
1370	  cmd_val.wait_complete = 1;
1371	  cmd_val.card_num = priv->slot;
1372	  cmd_val.use_hold_reg = 1;
1373	  cmd_val.start_command = 1;
1374	
1375	  /* Wait for previous command to be taken */
1376	
1377	  watchtime = clock_systime_ticks();
1378	  while (!sdmmc_ll_is_command_taken(&SDMMC))
1379	    {
1380	      if (clock_systime_ticks() - watchtime > SDCARD_CMDTIMEOUT)
1381	        {
1382	          mcerr("TMO waiting for command taken\n");
1383	          return -ETIMEDOUT;
1384	        }
1385	    }
1386	
1387	  sdmmc_ll_set_command_arg(&SDMMC, 0);
1388	  sdmmc_ll_set_command(&SDMMC, cmd_val);
1389	
1390	  /* Wait for command to complete */
1391	
1392	  watchtime = clock_systime_ticks();
1393	  while (!sdmmc_ll_is_command_taken(&SDMMC))
1394	    {
1395	      if (clock_systime_ticks() - watchtime > SDCARD_CMDTIMEOUT)
1396	        {
1397	          mcerr("TMO waiting for clock update complete\n");
1398	          return -ETIMEDOUT;
1399	        }
1400	    }
1401	
1402	  return OK;
1403	}

1405	/****************************************************************************
1406	 * Name: sdmmc_host_get_clk_dividers
1407	 *
1408	 * Description:
1409	 *   Calculate clock dividers for the requested frequency.
1410	 *
1411	 *   We have two clock divider stages:
1412	 *   - Host divider: divides the source clock (160MHz PLL160M)
1413	 *   - Card divider: divides the host clock by 2*n
1414	 *
1415	 * Input Parameters:
1416	 *   freq_khz - Requested frequency in kHz
1417	 *   host_div - Output: host clock divider
1418	 *   card_div - Output: card clock divider
1419	 *
1420	 * Returned Value:
1421	 *   None
1422	 *
1423	 ****************************************************************************/
1424	
1425	static void sdmmc_host_get_clk_dividers(uint32_t freq_khz, int *host_div,
1426	                                        int *card_div)
1427	{
1428	  /* For ESP32P4, we use PLL160M (160MHz) as the source clock.
1429	   *
1430	   * The host divider can be 1-16 (configured in HP_SYS_CLKRST registers).
1431	   * The card divider can be 0 (bypass) or 1-255 (actual div = 2*card_div).
1432	   *
1433	   * actual_freq = clk_src / host_div                   when card_div == 0
1434	   * actual_freq = clk_src / host_div / (2 * card_div)  when card_div > 0
1435	   */
1436	
1437	  uint32_t clk_src_freq_khz = BOARD_SDMMC_FREQUENCY / 1000;
1438	
1439	  if (freq_khz >= clk_src_freq_khz)
1440	    {
1441	      /* Maximum frequency: source clock / 1 */
1442	
1443	      *host_div = 1;
1444	      *card_div = 0;
1445	    }
1446	  else if (freq_khz >= clk_src_freq_khz / 2)
1447	    {
1448	      *host_div = 2;
1449	      *card_div = 0;
1450	    }
1451	  else if (freq_khz >= clk_src_freq_khz / 4)
1452	    {
1453	      *host_div = 4;
1454	      *card_div = 0;
1455	    }
1456	  else if (freq_khz >= clk_src_freq_khz / 8)
1457	    {
1458	      *host_div = 8;
1459	      *card_div = 0;
1460	    }
1461	  else if (freq_khz >= clk_src_freq_khz / 16)
1462	    {
1463	      *host_div = 16;
1464	      *card_div = 0;
1465	    }
1466	  else
1467	    {
1468	      /* Need two-stage division */
1469	
1470	      uint32_t target_hz = freq_khz * 1000;
1471	      uint32_t total_div = (BOARD_SDMMC_FREQUENCY + target_hz - 1) / target_hz;
1472	
1473	      if (total_div <= 16)
1474	        {
1475	          *host_div = (int)total_div;
1476	          *card_div = 0;
1477	        }
1478	      else
1479	        {
1480	          /* Two-stage: find best combination */
1481	
1482	          *host_div = 2;
1483	          *card_div = 255;
1484	          for (int h = 2; h <= 16; h++)
1485	            {
1486	              uint32_t intermediate = BOARD_SDMMC_FREQUENCY / h;
1487	              int c = (int)((intermediate + 2 * target_hz - 1) /
1488	                       (2 * target_hz));
1489	              if (c < 1)
1490	                {
1491	                  c = 1;
1492	                }
1493	              if (c <= 255)
1494	                {
1495	                  *host_div = h;
1496	                  *card_div = c;
1497	                  break;
1498	                }
1499	            }
1500	        }
1501	    }
1502	
1503	  mcinfo("freq_khz=%" PRIu32 " host_div=%d card_div=%d\n",
1504	         freq_khz, *host_div, *card_div);
1505	}
1506	
1507	/****************************************************************************
1508	 * Name: sdmmc_host_set_clk_div
1509	 *
1510	 * Description:
1511	 *   Set the clock dividers in the hardware.
1512	 *
1513	 * Input Parameters:
1514	 *   slot     - Slot number
1515	 *   host_div - Host clock divider
1516	 *   card_div - Card clock divider
1517	 *
1518	 * Returned Value:
1519	 *   None
1520	 *
1521	 ****************************************************************************/
1522	
1523	static void sdmmc_host_set_clk_div(uint32_t slot, uint32_t host_div,
1524	                                   uint32_t card_div)
1525	{
1526	  /* Disable card clock first */
1527	
1528	  sdmmc_ll_enable_card_clock(&SDMMC, slot, false);
1529	  sdmmc_host_clock_update_command(&g_sdiodev);
1530	
1531	  /* Set host clock divider (in HP_SYS_CLKRST registers) */
1532	
1533	  sdmmc_ll_set_clock_div(&SDMMC, host_div);
1534	
1535	  /* Select PLL160M as clock source */
1536	
1537	  sdmmc_ll_select_clk_source(&SDMMC, SDMMC_CLK_SRC_PLL160M);
1538	
1539	  /* Initialize phase delays */
1540	
1541	  sdmmc_ll_init_phase_delay(&SDMMC);
1542	
1543	  /* Set card clock divider */
1544	
1545	  sdmmc_ll_set_card_clock_div(&SDMMC, slot, card_div);
1546	
1547	  /* Send clock update command */
1548	
1549	  sdmmc_host_clock_update_command(&g_sdiodev);
1550	
1551	  /* Re-enable card clock */
1552	
1553	  sdmmc_ll_enable_card_clock(&SDMMC, slot, true);
1554	  sdmmc_ll_enable_card_clock_low_power(&SDMMC, slot, true);
1555	  sdmmc_host_clock_update_command(&g_sdiodev);
1556	
1557	  /* Set timeouts */
1558	
1559	  uint32_t freq_khz = BOARD_SDMMC_FREQUENCY / host_div /
1560	                       ((card_div == 0) ? 1 : card_div * 2) / 1000;
1561	  uint32_t data_timeout_ms = 100;
1562	  uint32_t data_timeout_cycles = data_timeout_ms * freq_khz;
1563	  sdmmc_ll_set_data_timeout(&SDMMC, data_timeout_cycles);
1564	  sdmmc_ll_set_response_timeout(&SDMMC, 255);
1565	
1566	  mcinfo("slot=%" PRIu32 " host_div=%" PRIu32 " card_div=%" PRIu32 "\n",
1567	         slot, host_div, card_div);
1568	}

1570	/****************************************************************************
1571	 * Name: esp32p4_clock
1572	 *
1573	 * Description:
1574	 *   Enable/disable SDIO clocking
1575	 *
1576	 * Input Parameters:
1577	 *   dev  - An instance of the SDIO device interface
1578	 *   rate - Specifies the clocking to use (see enum sdio_clock_e)
1579	 *
1580	 * Returned Value:
1581	 *   None
1582	 *
1583	 ****************************************************************************/
1584	
1585	static void esp32p4_clock(struct sdio_dev_s *dev, enum sdio_clock_e rate)
1586	{
1587	  struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32p4_dev_s *)dev;
1588	  uint32_t freq_khz;
1589	  int host_div;
1590	  int card_div;
1591	
1592	  mcinfo("rate=%d\n", rate);
1593	
1594	  switch (rate)
1595	    {
1596	      case CLOCK_SDIO_DISABLED:
1597	        sdmmc_ll_enable_card_clock(&SDMMC, priv->slot, false);
1598	        sdmmc_host_clock_update_command(priv);
1599	        return;
1600	
1601	      case CLOCK_IDMODE:
1602	        /* Initial ID mode clocking (<400KHz) */
1603	
1604	        freq_khz = 400;
1605	        break;
1606	
1607	      case CLOCK_MMC_TRANSFER:
1608	        /* MMC normal operation clocking (up to 52MHz) */
1609	
1610	        freq_khz = 52000;
1611	        break;
1612	
1613	      case CLOCK_SD_TRANSFER_1BIT:
1614	      case CLOCK_SD_TRANSFER_4BIT:
1615	        /* SD normal operation clocking (up to 50MHz) */
1616	
1617	        freq_khz = 50000;
1618	        break;
1619	
1620	      default:
1621	        mcerr("ERROR: Unknown rate: %d\n", rate);
1622	        return;
1623	    }
1624	
1625	  /* Calculate and set clock dividers */
1626	
1627	  sdmmc_host_get_clk_dividers(freq_khz, &host_div, &card_div);
1628	  sdmmc_host_set_clk_div(priv->slot, host_div, card_div);
1629	}

1764	    }

1833	/****************************************************************************
1834	 * Name: esp32p4_cancel
1835	 *
1836	 * Description:
1837	 *   Cancel the data transfer setup of SDIO_RECVSETUP, SDIO_SENDSETUP,
1838	 *   SDIO_DMARECVSETUP or SDIO_DMASENDSETUP.  This must be called to cancel
1839	 *   the data transfer setup if, for some reason, you cannot perform the
1840	 *   transfer.
1841	 *
1842	 * Input Parameters:
1843	 *   dev  - An instance of the SDIO device interface
1844	 *
1845	 * Returned Value:
1846	 *   OK is success; a negated errno on failure
1847	 *
1848	 ****************************************************************************/
1849	
1850	static int esp32p4_cancel(struct sdio_dev_s *dev)
1851	{
1852	  struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32p4_dev_s *)dev;
1853	
1854	  mcinfo("Cancelling transfer\n");
1855	
1856	  /* Disable all transfer-related interrupts */
1857	
1858	  esp32p4_disable_allints(priv);
1859	
1860	  /* Reset the data state machine */
1861	
1862	  SDMMC.ctrl.abort_read_data = 1;
1863	
1864	  /* Wait for the abort to complete */
1865	
1866	  clock_t watchtime = clock_systime_ticks();
1867	  while (SDMMC.ctrl.abort_read_data)
1868	    {
1869	      if (clock_systime_ticks() - watchtime > SDCARD_CMDTIMEOUT)
1870	        {
1871	          mcerr("TMO waiting for abort\n");
1872	          break;
1873	        }
1874	    }
1875	
1876	  /* Reset the FIFO */
1877	
1878	  sdmmc_ll_reset_fifo(&SDMMC);
1879	  while (!sdmmc_ll_is_fifo_reset_done(&SDMMC))
1880	    {
1881	    }
1882	
1883	  /* Clear any pending interrupts */
1884	
1885	  sdmmc_ll_clear_interrupt(&SDMMC, 0xffffffff);
1886	
1887	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_DMA
1888	  /* Stop DMA */
1889	
1890	  sdmmc_ll_stop_dma(&SDMMC);
1891	  sdmmc_ll_clear_idsts_interrupt(&SDMMC, 0xffffffff);
1892	#endif
1893	
1894	  priv->remaining = 0;
1895	  priv->buffer    = NULL;
1896	
1897	  return OK;
1898	}

1900	/****************************************************************************
1901	 * Name: esp32p4_waitresponse
1902	 *
1903	 * Description:
1904	 *   Poll-wait for the response to the last command to be ready.  This
1905	 *   function should be called even after sending commands that have no
1906	 *   response (such as CMD0) to make sure that the hardware is ready to
1907	 *   receive the next command.
1908	 *
1909	 * Input Parameters:
1910	 *   dev  - An instance of the SDIO device interface
1911	 *   cmd  - The command that was sent. See 32-bit command definitions above.
1912	 *
1913	 * Returned Value:
1914	 *   OK is success; a negated errno on failure
1915	 *
1916	 ****************************************************************************/
1917	
1918	static int esp32p4_waitresponse(struct sdio_dev_s *dev, uint32_t cmd)
1919	{
1920	  clock_t watchtime;
1921	  uint32_t status;
1922	
1923	  mcinfo("cmd: %08" PRIx32 "\n", cmd);
1924	
1925	  /* Wait for command completion or response.
1926	   *
1927	   * Poll-wait for the command to complete.  This is not the normal path
1928	   * for SDIO operations; normally, the interrupt handler will detect
1929	   * command completion.
1930	   */
1931	
1932	  watchtime = clock_systime_ticks();
1933	
1934	  for (; ; )
1935	    {
1936	      /* Check for command done */
1937	
1938	      status = sdmmc_ll_get_interrupt_raw(&SDMMC);
1939	
1940	      if ((status & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_CMD_DONE) != 0)
1941	        {
1942	          /* Clear the command done interrupt */
1943	
1944	          sdmmc_ll_clear_interrupt(&SDMMC, SDMMC_LL_EVENT_CMD_DONE);
1945	          break;
1946	        }
1947	
1948	      /* Check for response timeout */
1949	
1950	      if ((status & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RTO) != 0)
1951	        {
1952	          /* Clear the timeout interrupt */
1953	
1954	          sdmmc_ll_clear_interrupt(&SDMMC, SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RTO);
1955	          mcerr("ERROR: Response timeout\n");
1956	          return -ETIMEDOUT;
1957	        }
1958	
1959	      /* Check for response CRC error */
1960	
1961	      if ((status & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RCRC) != 0)
1962	        {
1963	          /* Clear the CRC error interrupt */
1964	
1965	          sdmmc_ll_clear_interrupt(&SDMMC, SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RCRC);
1966	          mcerr("ERROR: Response CRC error\n");
1967	          return -EIO;
1968	        }
1969	
1970	      /* Check for response error */
1971	
1972	      if ((status & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RESP_ERR) != 0)
1973	        {
1974	          /* Clear the response error interrupt */
1975	
1976	          sdmmc_ll_clear_interrupt(&SDMMC, SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RESP_ERR);
1977	          mcerr("ERROR: Response error\n");
1978	          return -EIO;
1979	        }
1980	
1981	      /* Check for timeout */
1982	
1983	      if ((clock_systime_ticks() - watchtime) > SDCARD_CMDTIMEOUT)
1984	        {
1985	          mcerr("TMO waiting for response\n");
1986	          return -ETIMEDOUT;
1987	        }
1988	    }
1989	
1990	  return OK;
1991	}

2013	                                uint32_t *rshort)
2014	{
2015	  mcinfo("cmd: %08" PRIx32 "\n", cmd);
2016	
2017	  /* Read the response from the response register */
2018	
2019	  *rshort = SDMMC.resp[0];

2026	/****************************************************************************
2027	 * Name: esp32p4_recvlong
2028	 *
2029	 * Description:
2030	 *   Receive response to SDIO command.  Only the critical payload is
2031	 *   returned -- 128 bits for 136 bit status.  The driver implementation
2032	 *   verifies the correctness of the remaining, non-returned bits (CRCs, CMD
2033	 *   index, etc.).
2034	 *
2035	 * Input Parameters:
2036	 *   dev  - An instance of the SDIO device interface
2037	 *   cmd  - The command that was sent
2038	 *   rlong - Buffer in which to receive the response (4 x 32-bit)
2039	 *
2040	 * Returned Value:
2041	 *   OK on success; a negated errno on failure.
2042	 *
2043	 ****************************************************************************/
2044	
2045	static int esp32p4_recvlong(struct sdio_dev_s *dev, uint32_t cmd,
2046	                            uint32_t rlong[4])
2047	{
2048	  mcinfo("cmd: %08" PRIx32 "\n", cmd);
2049	
2050	  /* Read the long response from the response registers.
2051	   * The SDMMC controller stores the response in reverse order:
2052	   * resp[0] = bits [127:96]
2053	   * resp[1] = bits [95:64]
2054	   * resp[2] = bits [63:32]
2055	   * resp[3] = bits [31:0]
2056	   *
2057	   * NuttX expects:
2058	   * rlong[0] = bits [127:96]
2059	   * rlong[1] = bits [95:64]
2060	   * rlong[2] = bits [63:32]
2061	   * rlong[3] = bits [31:0]
2062	   */
2063	
2064	  rlong[0] = SDMMC.resp[3];
2065	  rlong[1] = SDMMC.resp[2];
2066	  rlong[2] = SDMMC.resp[1];
2067	  rlong[3] = SDMMC.resp[0];
2068	
2069	  mcinfo("response: %08" PRIx32 " %08" PRIx32 " %08" PRIx32 " %08" PRIx32
2070	         "\n", rlong[0], rlong[1], rlong[2], rlong[3]);
2071	
2072	  return OK;
2073	}

2108	/****************************************************************************
2109	 * Name: esp32p4_waitenable
2110	 *
2111	 * Description:
2112	 *   Enable/disable of a set of SDIO wait events.  This is part of the
2113	 *   the SDIO_WAITEVENT sequence.  The set of to-be-waited-for events is
2114	 *   configured before calling esp32p4_eventwait.  This is done in this way
2115	 *   to help the driver to eliminate race conditions between the command
2116	 *   setup and the subsequent events.
2117	 *
2118	 *   The enabled events persist until either (1) SDIO_WAITENABLE is called
2119	 *   again specifying a different set of wait events, or (2) SDIO_EVENTWAIT
2120	 *   returns.
2121	 *
2122	 * Input Parameters:
2123	 *   dev      - An instance of the SDIO device interface
2124	 *   eventset - A bitset of events to enable or disable (see SDIOWAIT_*
2125	 *              definitions). 0=disable; 1=enable.
2126	 *   timeout  - Maximum time in milliseconds to wait
2127	 *
2128	 * Returned Value:
2129	 *   None
2130	 *
2131	 ****************************************************************************/
2132	
2133	static void esp32p4_waitenable(struct sdio_dev_s *dev, sdio_eventset_t eventset,
2134	                               uint32_t timeout)
2135	{
2136	  struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32p4_dev_s *)dev;
2137	  uint32_t waitmask = 0;
2138	
2139	  mcinfo("eventset: %02x timeout: %" PRIu32 "\n", eventset, timeout);
2140	
2141	  /* Disable previous wait interrupts */
2142	
2143	  esp32p4_config_waitints(priv, 0, 0, 0);
2144	
2145	  /* Clear any pending interrupts */
2146	
2147	  sdmmc_ll_clear_interrupt(&SDMMC, 0xffffffff);
2148	
2149	  /* Enable interrupts based on the requested events */
2150	
2151	  if ((eventset & SDIOWAIT_CMDDONE) != 0)
2152	    {
2153	      waitmask |= SDCARD_CMDDONE_MASK;
2154	    }
2155	
2156	  if ((eventset & SDIOWAIT_RESPONSEDONE) != 0)
2157	    {
2158	      waitmask |= SDCARD_RESPDONE_MASK;
2159	    }
2160	
2161	  if ((eventset & SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT) != 0)
2162	    {
2163	      /* Start the watchdog timer */
2164	
2165	      wd_start(&priv->waitwdog, MSEC2TICK(timeout),
2166	               esp32p4_eventtimeout, (wdparm_t)priv);
2167	    }
2168	
2169	  /* Enable the wait interrupts */
2170	
2171	  esp32p4_config_waitints(priv, waitmask, eventset, 0);
2172	}

2174	/****************************************************************************
2175	 * Name: esp32p4_eventwait
2176	 *
2177	 * Description:
2178	 *   Wait for one of the enabled events to occur (or a timeout).  Note that
2179	 *   all events enabled by SDIO_WAITEVENTS are disabled when
2180	 *   esp32p4_eventwait returns.  SDIO_WAITEVENTS must be called again before
2181	 *   esp32p4_eventwait can be used again.
2182	 *
2183	 * Input Parameters:
2184	 *   dev - An instance of the SDIO device interface
2185	 *
2186	 * Returned Value:
2187	 *   Event set containing the event(s) that ended the wait.  Should always
2188	 *   be non-zero.  All events are disabled after the wait concludes.
2189	 *
2190	 ****************************************************************************/
2191	
2192	static sdio_eventset_t esp32p4_eventwait(struct sdio_dev_s *dev)
2193	{
2194	  struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32p4_dev_s *)dev;
2195	  sdio_eventset_t wkupevent;
2196	  irqstate_t flags;
